description: The technical review of a sorting requirement. Every test it says already covers part of it must exist, the inventory page must be among the page objects, and it must name nearby behaviour.

input.title: Sort products
input.body: As a shopper I want to sort the product list by name or price so I can find what I want faster.
input.requirements:
## Requirements: Sort products (REQ-0)

**As** a shopper, **I want** to sort the product list by name or price, **so that** I find what I want faster.

| | Kind | Given | When | Then |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| AC-1 | happy | the product list | the shopper picks Price (low to high) | the cheapest product is first |
| AC-2 | negative | the list sorted by price | the shopper adds an item to the cart | the order does not change |
| AC-3 | edge | the list sorted by price | the shopper reloads | the control label matches the order shown |
